findings.evidence: The sole use of `hT` in the proof is line 85: `ContinuousLinearMap.orthogonalComplement_iSup_eigenspaces_eq_bot hT hT'`; all remaining construction uses only `hT'` and the resulting vanishing orthogonal complement.
findings.fix: First prove an operator-level theorem from symmetry plus `(⨆ μ, eigenspace (T : Module.End 𝕜 E) μ)ᗮ = ⊥`; derive the compact theorem using `ContinuousLinearMap.orthogonalComplement_iSup_eigenspaces_eq_bot`, and derive the injective variant from that general result.
findings.issue: `exists_hilbertBasis_hasEigenvector` and its line-108 nonzero variant are under-generalized: compactness is used only to obtain `(⨆ μ, eigenspace T μ)ᗮ = ⊥`, excluding noncompact pure-point symmetric operators such as the identity on an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space.

summary: The abstract eigenbasis API assumes compactness although its construction only needs completeness of the eigenspace span.
